'''Version 1.9.7''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on November 21st 2022.  It was 15.51 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*[[Overseer]] applying [[Debar|debar]] instead of [[Needler|needler]] in its projectiles
*"The name inheritance was improvised" change reverted 
*Parasite death will no longer decrease [[Evolution Phases|phases]]
*Fixed [[Dispatcher Nidus|Dispatcher Tile Entity]] not working (problem with collecting killcount from other parasites)
*Nidus Blocks not spawning [[Stage I Dispatcher|Dispatcher]]
*[[Assimilated Enderman]] sound effect volume
*[[Assimilated Bear]] sound effect volume
*[[Assimilated Pig]] sound effect volume
*[[Adapted Reeker]] sound effect volume

====<u>New</u>====
*[[Assimilated Big Spider]] sounds
*[[Assimilated Enderman]] portal sound

====<u>Configuration</u>====
*"Version [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Point Reduction Value" from 0.5 to 0.05
*"[[Adaptation System|Adaptation]] New Damage Cooldown" from 10 to 20

*New options:
**"[[Bogle]] Griefing" - "Set to true if you want the Bogle to destroy blocks on explosion." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Assimilated Adventurer]] To [[Thrall]]" - "How many kills an Assimilated Adventurer needs to become a Thrall." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg

====<u>Mobs</u>====
[[Heavy Bomber]] bomb damage from 25 to 80
Decreased the rate of [[Marauder]], [[Warden]] and [[Monarch]] spawning [[Seizer|Seizers]]

====<u>General changes</u>====
*Nade entities "tweaked texture
